description: Prepare a deposit of USDG into an LP vault, which lends against LP positions in the pools of its mandate. Refused while the vault is impaired, its deposits are closed or the registry no longer lets it lend. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

amount.description: USDG to deposit, raw units (6 decimals)

maxSlippageBps.description: Most the conversion may move against you, in bps; 50 when omitted

vault.description: An LP vault: one gage_lp_vaults lists (the manifest's, or one a curator opened through the lane's factory)

name: gage_prepare_lp_deposit
title: Prepare: Deposit into an LP vault
